<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_INQ_IP" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/inq-ip">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TransactionDataRequest" name="Transaction data request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TransactionData" name="Transaction data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Rejection" name="Rejection"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_INQ_IP">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_INQ" name="INQ" processRef="Process_INQ"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IP" name="IP" processRef="Process_IP"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Request" name="Transaction data request" sourceRef="Task_TransmitRequest" targetRef="Start_RequestReceived" messageRef="Message_TransactionDataRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Data" name="Transaction data" sourceRef="Task_SendData" targetRef="Task_ReceiveData" messageRef="Message_TransactionData"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Rejection" name="Rejection" sourceRef="Task_SendRejection" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRejection" messageRef="Message_Rejection"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_INQ" name="INQ" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_INQ" name="Begin request"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_TransmitRequest" name="Transmit transaction data request" messageRef="Message_TransactionDataRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForAnswer" name="Wait for IP answer" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveData" name="Receive transaction data" messageRef="Message_TransactionData"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRejection" name="Receive rejection" messageRef="Message_Rejection"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_DataReceived" name="Transaction data received"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RejectionReceived" name="Rejection received"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_1" sourceRef="Start_INQ" targetRef="Task_TransmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_2" sourceRef="Task_TransmitRequest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForAnswer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_3" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAnswer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_4" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAnswer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveData" targetRef="End_DataReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRejection" targetRef="End_RejectionReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_IP" name="IP" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_RequestReceived" name="Transaction data request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RequestReceived" messageRef="Message_TransactionDataRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequest" name="Check INQ request"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ExaminationOutcome" name="Examination outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendData" name="Send transaction data" messageRef="Message_TransactionData"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRejection" name="Send rejection" messageRef="Message_Rejection"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_DataSent" name="Transaction data sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RejectionSent" name="Rejection sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_1" sourceRef="Start_RequestReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequest" targetRef="Gateway_ExaminationOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_3" name="Transmission of data" sourceRef="Gateway_ExaminationOutcome" targetRef="Task_SendData">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">examinationOutcome = "transmission of data"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_4" name="Rejection" sourceRef="Gateway_ExaminationOutcome" targetRef="Task_SendRejection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">examinationOutcome = "rejection"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_5" sourceRef="Task_SendData" targetRef="End_DataSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_6" sourceRef="Task_SendRejection" targetRef="End_RejectionSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
